title: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate, GBP per EUR (daily).
fetch_command: euroflex data gb fetch fx  (or: .venv/bin/python scripts/research/gb_fetch_data.py --target fx)
source: European Central Bank data portal (data-api.ecb.europa.eu), series EXR.D.GBP.EUR.SP00.A
licence: ECB terms of use (free reuse with source citation)
licence_terms: Free use of information obtained from the ECB website provided it appears accurately and the ECB is cited as the source; modifications (here: as-of join of daily rates onto delivery dates) must be stated.
attribution: Source: European Central Bank (euro foreign exchange reference rates)
transformation_notes: timestamp_utc = reference date 00:00 UTC (rates are set around 16:00 CET on TARGET business days).
gbp_per_eur = OBS_VALUE (pound sterling per euro). Consumers as-of join the latest rate dated on or before each delivery date (forward fill over weekends and holidays).
